items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: She said she never liked Clarence, but she liked him.

ctx.x: Larry Shields. Wonderful. His brother plays good too down the road. This person was just here. They think that there's nobody like the Shields playing on it now with Chalky. Yeah, Harry is. She said she never liked Clarence, but she liked him.
Yeah, very good. Any other trombone players? How did Happy Schilling play? He's retired now. I talked to him.
